eligible_nationalities.note: Regulation-sourced list kept separate from the page verbatim, which says only 'warga negara tertentu'. 13 states/SARs from Perpres 95/2024 Lampiran A and 6 added by Permenimipas 10/2026 Lampiran; the official BVK portal page shows the same 19. Added under OWNER RULING 2026-10-19.

sources.note: Bebas Visa Kunjungan; Lampiran A 13 states/SAR, Lampiran B Singapore certain-permit holders
Ditetapkan 2026-07-07; diundangkan 2026-07-09 (BN 2026 No. 463 per press; PDF placeholder unfilled); adds TR BR PE KZ MO BY; Pasal 4 revokes Permenimipas 10/2025 (BN 2025 No. 594)

permit_holder_route.text_id: Pemegang izin tinggal tertentu dari negara Singapura
permit_holder_route.scope: Holders of certain Singapore stay permits (the imigrasi.go.id BVK page: Singapore permanent-resident holders arriving through certain TPI). Not nationality-based.
permit_holder_route.to_verify: The revoked Permenimipas 10/2025 title covered 'atau Pemegang Izin Tinggal Tertentu'; the 10/2026 title drops that phrase. Perpres 95/2024 Lampiran B and the portal page still state the route. NB-2 (council ground truth, 2026-10-19) says the Lampiran B route applies only at certain entry points in Kepulauan Riau; not verified against the instrument. A holder answering yes gets TO_VERIFY, never OK.

eligible_nationalities.b1_overlap_note: 18 of the 19 listed nationalities (all except MO) are also on the B1 visa-on-arrival list; A1 eligibility never excludes B1.

owner_rulings.ruling: A1 eligibility is decided from the 19-entry regulation list (Perpres 95/2024 Lampiran A + Permenimipas 10/2026 Lampiran) plus the Singapore permit-holder route (Perpres 95/2024 Lampiran B), not from a bare self-confirmation. A yes on the Singapore permit-holder route gives TO_VERIFY (gate 2026-10-19).
